description: AI-generated illustrations depict NASA insignia as a fictional uniform reference. ASTRA is an independent project; no NASA affiliation or endorsement is claimed.
rights: NASA insignia is a third-party government mark, excluded from the project's Apache license grant; its use is subject to NASA's rules.
review: Visually reviewed: small recognizable blue NASA patches and independent-project footer added; compositions, resource icons, dialogue, cooperative badges, and sealed plants preserved. Patches also appear on some companion suits. Generated patches are illustrative, not verified exact reproductions.
